name: Savage Nomads
description: The Savage Nomads were a mostly Puerto Rican and African American street gang founded in the South Bronx, New York City, in the late 1960s by Cornell "Black Benji" Benjamin, a native of St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands. Originally known as "Nomads On Wheels," the gang was active primarily through the 1970s and engaged in territorial battles with rival gangs including the Seven Immortals, the Savage Skulls, and the Dirty Dozen. Like the Savage Skulls, members adopted Nazi iconography — swastikas, Nazi helmets, and a rank called "Gestapo" — to project menace rather than out of ideological affiliation. After a period of dormancy, the gang resurfaced around 2017 with two homicides linked to members.
